'''''Agapanthus campanulatus''''', the '''bell agapanthus''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Amaryllidaceae]] endemic to the [[Drakensberg]] in Southern Africa.<ref name="inaturalist-Agapanthus campanulatus">{{cite web |title=Bell Agapanthus (Agapanthus campanulatus) |url=https://www.inaturalist.org/taxa/336864-Agapanthus-campanulatus |access-date=2024-08-30 |website=iNaturalist |language=en}}</ref>

== Distribution ==
''Agapanthus campanulatus'' is found in the Drakensberg at a maximum altitude of 2400 m. It's found in moist grassland and rocky slopes in the Eastern Cape, Lesotho, KwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng and Mpumalanga. ''A. c.'' ''campanulatus'' is found at lower altitudes in the [[midlands of KwaZulu-Natal]],  the Eastern Cape and the Free State.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Agapanthus campanulatus {{!}} PlantZAfrica |url=https://pza.sanbi.org/agapanthus-campanulatus |access-date=2024-08-30 |website=pza.sanbi.org}}</ref>

== Conservation status ==
Both subspecies of ''A. campanulatus'' have been classified as least concern in the [[Red List of South African Plants]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Agapanthus campanulatus subsp. campanulatus {{!}} Threatened Species Programme {{!}} SANBI Red List of South African Plants |url=http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=481-3 |access-date=2024-08-30 |website=redlist.sanbi.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Agapanthus campanulatus subsp. patens {{!}} Threatened Species Programme {{!}} SANBI Red List of South African Plants |url=http://redlist.sanbi.org/species.php?species=481-2 |access-date=2024-08-30 |website=redlist.sanbi.org}}</ref>

== Taxonomy ==
''Agapanthus campanulatus'' contains two subspecies:<ref name="inaturalist-Agapanthus campanulatus" />

* ''Agapanthus campanulatus'' <small>F.M.Leight.</small> ''campanulatus''
* ''Agapanthus campanulatus'' <small>F.M.Leight.</small> ''patens'' <small>(F.M.Leight.) F.M.Leight.</small>
